title: 12 Best Sichuan Street Food in Chengdu (2026)

picks.name: Chen Mapo Tofu (陈麻婆豆腐)
picks.insiderTip: Go to the Qingyang or Jinniu branch for the most authentic experience.
picks.address: Jiefang Road Section 2, Jinniu District, Chengdu
picks.whatToOrder: Chen Mapo Doufu — original recipe with beef mince and doubanjiang
redditQuotes: Chengdu's food won't let you down
Mapo tofu is the dish

picks.name: Zhong Dumplings (钟水饺)
picks.insiderTip: Order the red oil version — the sweet chili oil sauce is what makes these legendary.
picks.address: 4 Wuhouci Da Jie, Wuhou District, Chengdu
redditQuotes: Sweet chili oil sauce is the star
A Chengdu classic you can't skip

picks.name: Long Chaoshou (龙抄手)
picks.insiderTip: Get the sampler plate to try 8-10 Chengdu classics at once.
picks.address: 9 Huanhua Bei Lu, Qingyang District, Chengdu
redditQuotes: Worth it for the snack sampler alone
Clear soup wontons are silky

picks.name: Lai Tangyuan (赖汤圆)
picks.insiderTip: The black sesame filling is the classic — warm, molten, and nutty.
redditQuotes: Time-honored brand
A sweet break from all the mala

picks.name: Dongzi Kou Zhang Lao'er Liangfen (洞子口张老二凉粉)
picks.insiderTip: Under ¥15 for a life-changing bowl of cold jelly noodles near Wenshu Monastery.
redditQuotes: The liangfen near Wenshu is legendary
The chili oil is perfection

picks.name: Xiaomingtang Tianshuimian (小名堂担担甜水面)
picks.insiderTip: The thick bouncy noodles in sweet-spicy sauce are uniquely Chengdu — you won't find this elsewhere.
redditQuotes: Thick noodles, sweet first, then a little heat
The sauce is addictive

picks.name: Jiazhou Yepopo Bobo Chicken (嘉州叶婆婆钵钵鸡)
picks.insiderTip: Try both the red oil and green pepper versions. Pick adventurous skewers like lotus root and wood ear.
picks.whatToOrder: Red Oil Bobo Chicken — mix of skewers
redditQuotes: You pick a few, share, move on
Each piece perfectly coated in addictive sauce

picks.name: Lao Ma Tihua (老妈蹄花)
picks.insiderTip: Go after 10 PM for the authentic late-night experience. Insist on the original branch near Qingyang.
picks.whatToOrder: Lao Ma Tihua pork trotter soup + cold vegetables
redditQuotes: Fall-off-the-bone tender in milky white broth
The late night move in Chengdu

picks.name: Yi Lao Da Dan Hong Gao (一老大蛋烘糕)
picks.insiderTip: At ¥3 each, get both sweet (brown sugar) and savory (pork floss). On Kuixinglou food street.
picks.whatToOrder: Brown Sugar + Pork Floss dan hong gao
redditQuotes: Soft, warm, filled with whatever you like
The snack that best represents everyday Chengdu

picks.name: Jinli Ancient Street (锦里古街)
picks.insiderTip: Go in the evening for lantern atmosphere. Try san da pao, rabbit heads, and stinky tofu.
picks.address: 231 Wuhouci Da Jie, Wuhou District, Chengdu
picks.whatToOrder: San Da Pao, rabbit head, liangfen, fried sweet rice balls
redditQuotes: Great for classic Chengdu snacks
Jinli at night with the lanterns is worth visiting

picks.name: Kuanzhai Alley (宽窄巷子)
picks.insiderTip: More refined than Jinli. Sit for gaiwan tea at a courtyard tea house and graze on snacks.
picks.address: Zhai Xiang Zi, Qingyang District, Chengdu
picks.whatToOrder: Gaiwan Tea + dan hong gao + chaoshou from vendors
redditQuotes: Street food haven
Better for sitting, sipping tea

picks.name: Ganji Feichang Fen (甘记肥肠粉)
picks.insiderTip: Order the feichang fen + guokui combo — the classic Chengdu breakfast pairing.
picks.address: 18 Ma'an Bei Lu, Jinniu District, Chengdu
redditQuotes: Warming and satisfying
The ultimate Chengdu street breakfast
